description: This file defines classes and functions for generating tensor operation strategies based on Einstein summation notation, including parsing equations, determining tensor dimension strategies, and creating device mesh strategies for distributed tensor computations.

classes.name: EinsumDims
classes.description: A data class representing the different dimension categories (contracting, batch, output-only) for Einstein summation operations, with methods to parse equations and dimensions.

methods.name: parse_equation
methods.description: Parses an Einstein summation equation string into input dimension lists and output dimension string.

methods.name: parse_dims
methods.description: Analyzes input dimensions and output dimension to categorize dimensions into contracting, batch, and output-only dimensions.

methods.name: gen_einsum_strategies
methods.description: Generates distributed tensor operation strategies based on the Einstein summation equation and device mesh, supporting sharding on various tensor dimensions and optional linearity.
